summary: Synthesised bass drum: BD Trigger fires it (written as an event: automation_write), with its tone, decay and volume. For simple kicks; Neo Drums is the modern one.
use_for: Synthesised kick drum fired by a trigger, with tone, decay and volume.
quirks: BD Trigger is an event: write a 1 with automation_write to play the drum; it does not follow notes.
BD Decay sets the release from about 17 ms (0) to 1.3 s (127), 150 ms by default.
BD Volume is declared but the code never reads it, and a sweep found no change: it has no effect.
A pitch sweep from about 250 Hz down to 1 Hz over the drum's length; BD Tone sets its filter.
BD Tone at its top is hot: +2.5 dBFS peak in the profile.
evidence: ExternalMachines/source/buzztrax-buzzmachines/Jeskola/Trilok/Trilok.cpp — parameters, the tone and decay formulas, and that BD Volume is never read
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-13) — one trigger -12 LUFS, decay 20 to 470 ms, BD Tone brightness 85 to 177 Hz

problems: hot (loud but steady) with BD Tone at its maximum (127): +2.5 dBFS peak

swept_because: every parameter at its maximum at once: hot

BD Trigger.evidence: a choice: its texts say what it is; no role measured

BD Decay.evidence: the level falls half way in 20 ms → 470 ms (the default 150 ms) to the same held level

BD Volume.evidence: no measurable change between its ends with the others at their defaults

parameters.name: BD Trigger
parameters.how: Fires the bass drum when written; it is an event, so it is played with automation_write rather than held.
parameters.sound: Each trigger plays one short, low kick.

parameters.name: BD Tone
parameters.how: Sets the drum's filter, 0 to 127; higher values open it and take the resonance away.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a brighter, clickier thump; lower ones a deeper, rounder boom.

parameters.name: BD Decay
parameters.how: Sets how long the drum takes to fade, from about 17 ms at 0 to about 1.3 s at 127.
parameters.sound: Short values give a tight tick; long ones give a booming tail.

parameters.name: BD Volume
parameters.how: Sets a level on a 0 to 254 scale, but the machine's source never reads it and a sweep heard no change.
parameters.sound: No audible effect; set the level on the machine's output instead.
